title: A test pins factdiff.today() to the UTC day between local and UTC midnight
goal: a suite test stubs the clock to an hour where the local day and the UTC day differ (a far-east TZ near UTC midnight) and asserts factdiff.today() names the UTC day, so a revert to date.today() fails the suite at any hour, not only inside that window
notes: Found by the SP-wjp5qllo review (S3): BG-gflil3ya's fix (f2765e8d9) makes factdiff.today() (factdiff.py:102) the UTC day, but no test pins it; only the live lookup-eval test would catch a revert, and only between local and UTC midnight.
